body:
Close ADR-0006 / issue #241 follow-ons that unblock the rest of the Cursor deeper-native wave: author the binding umbrella P1 spec, pin real Cursor hook payload shapes (especially session_id), and ship a sessionStart hook that injects ADLC ticket/rails context so an installed plugin feels ambient rather than forgotten.

Context: the Jul-2026 Cursor parity plan (issue #241 + plugins/adlc-cursor review) found Cursor underuses native plugin surfaces. T47 shipped marketplace distribution but deferred agents/MCP and left sessionStart unused. Current Cursor hooks docs pin sessionStart input `{ session_id, is_background_agent, composer_mode }` and output `{ env, additional_context }`. ADR-0006 still TODOs payload field pins and TTL-based buildgate depth because session id was unverified.

=== CONTRACT (write then gate) ===
Author `.adlc/specs/cursor-deeper-native.md` BEFORE coding. It is the binding umbrella for T64–T69 and must pin:
1. Workstream map: T64 sessionStart/payload pin → T65 MCP → T66 agents+Task prosecute → T67 preCompact/subagent hooks → T68 live deny-proof → T69 marketplace publish + /adlc-init DX.
2. Honesty: CI rails-guard remains the unbypassable control; in-session deny stays best-effort (failClosed:false).
3. No invented hook events — only Cursor-documented events (sessionStart, preCompact, subagentStart/Stop, etc.).
4. Agents/MCP previously out-of-scope in T47 are IN SCOPE for T65/T66; live deny-proof remains T68 (maintainer binary).
5. Stale claim "Cursor has no subagent fan-out" in command/adlc-prosecute.md must be retired by T66, not this ticket.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Spec file above.
2. Capture/fixture of real or docs-pinned sessionStart + preToolUse field names; update defensive extractors and ADR-0006 "Resolved Cursor hook facts" / Unverified sections.
3. New `hooks/adlc-session-start.mjs` wired in plugin `hooks/hooks.json` + root `hooks.json` + scaffolder merge path (`plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/scaffold.mjs` `mergeHooks`, in ticket scope): on sessionStart, resolve active ticket (reuse generated-active-ticket / existing helpers), return `additional_context` summarizing active ticket id, rails on/off, phase hint, and `env` including at least a session-scoped id derived from `session_id` for downstream hooks.
4. Switch buildgate depth to **per-session counters** keyed by `ADLC_CURSOR_SESSION_ID` / `session_id` (not a single shared slot that resets on id change). Keep TTL cleanup of stale session entries + anonymous TTL singleton fallback when no id. Interleaving test required: calls A1,B1,A2,B2 → depths 1,1,2,2. Update constants/tests.
5. Fix stale "DISABLED BY DEFAULT" header comments on stop/preflight hooks to match T47 default-on truth.
6. Extend `scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs` + unit tests for sessionStart wiring and session_id scoping.
7. Docs truth: ADR-0006, docs/integrations/cursor.md, matrix cell notes if the file is present on the branch; do not claim deny is proven (that is T68).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: `.adlc/specs/cursor-deeper-native.md` exists and names T64–T69 with binding decisions above. VERIFY: file present + smoke/assert or packaging test that references it.
- AC2: `sessionStart` is present in plugin hooks/hooks.json pointing at the new script with failClosed:false. VERIFY: `node scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs .`
- AC3: Per-session depth counters: interleaved sessions A/B produce independent counts (A1,B1,A2,B2 → 1,1,2,2); TTL expires stale session entries; anonymous (no id) keeps TTL singleton fallback. VERIFY: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC4: sessionStart returns additional_context mentioning the active ticket when `.adlc/current-ticket.json` resolves; returns a clear "no active ticket" context when absent. VERIFY: unit test with temp dirs.
- AC5: ADR-0006 no longer lists session_id as unverified if pinned; stop/preflight comments no longer say DISABLED BY DEFAULT. VERIFY: ripgrep assertions in smoke or docs test.
- AC6: `adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket T64` passes for this ticket's rails; root relevant tests pass.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- MCP, agents, /adlc-prosecute rewrite (T65/T66).
- preCompact / subagentStart (T67).
- Live Cursor binary deny-proof (T68).
- cursor.com/marketplace human publish (T69).
- Changing @adlc/core rail decision semantics.

=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 2) ===
- sessionStart additional_context is best-effort; ship/extend rules/adlc.mdc fallback to read current-ticket pointer (AC17). Scope includes plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/**.
- Resolve consumer workspace via CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR / workspace_roots (not plugin cwd); test 0/1/N ADLC roots with cwd=plugin dir.
- Depth state: atomic per-session files or lock/CAS; concurrent multi-process bump test (no lost updates).
- Checked-in preToolUse + sessionStart fixtures under test/fixtures; ADR unverified bullets retired (AC18).


=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 3) ===
- Depth increment: lock or CAS-with-retry (rename-only insufficient).
- P5 marker must match sessionId; cross-session isolation required.
- Workspace resolution: prefer active-ticket-bearing roots; validate CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR is ADLC-bearing; multi-active roots report ambiguity.


=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 4) ===
- Dedicated alwaysApply:true ticket-context rule + non-destructive scaffold upgrade (AC17).
- Workspace candidates = workspace_roots ∪ ADLC-bearing CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR; active roots win; multi-active = ambiguity; env cannot hide another active root.


=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 5) ===
- Rule upgrade: stock-hash or managed-block only; sentinel+user-drift → keep + propose/backup.
- Error-bearing roots (canonical pointer fail-closed) before active/inactive; never call those "no active ticket".
- Normalize Cursor Windows /c:/ paths before ADLC checks.
- Depth locks: ownership token, finally release, bounded acquire, stale-lease reclaim; crash-recovery test.


=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 6) ===
- AC2: marketplace vs scaffold/package-root sessionStart command paths may differ (T47 policy); assert semantic lockstep not identical strings.
- P1 review boundary: missing T64 implementation is not a P1 no-ship for this spec.


=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (round 7) ===
- alwaysApply fallback must use canonical ticket resolution (not raw pointer/env).

undefined
=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS (binding via umbrella spec) ===
- ADLC-bearing roots use canonical detectTicketStore semantics: directory
  (.adlc/tickets/), legacy (.adlc/tickets.json), and override stores. Dual-store
  / pending-transaction / conflict -> error-bearing (not "no active ticket").
- Depth increments are idempotent on tool_use_id under the same CAS/leased lock.
- sessionStart persists .adlc/cursor-session-workspace-<sessionId>.json for MCP.

- MCP fallback uses user-scoped ~/.adlc/cursor-session-workspaces.json (not in-repo-only).

=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS ===
- Zero ADLC candidates => unresolved (never process.cwd() / plugin cwd).
- T64 owns user-scoped session index upsert (AC19); T65 only consumes it.

=== P1 ===
safeId = SHA-256 hex of session id; no sessionless MCP index fallback.

=== P1 ===
Depth lock fencing before commit; paused-holder race test required.

=== P1 ===
env/payload session conflict => no named session state mutation.

=== P1 ===
Failed resolution must tombstone/clear session index (omit forbidden).

=== P1 ===
Session index: whole-file lock/CAS with fencing across sessions.

=== P1 ===
Depth state: one counter per session at sessionStart-resolved root or ~/.adlc.

=== P1 ===
Session index T64-only until handoff; P5 marker shares depth storage root.

=== P1 ===
Missing tool_use_id => per-delivery bump; P5 marker runId compare-and-delete.

=== P1 ===
Versioned session-resolution records/tombstones for AC17; enforcement === "1"; conflict no mutation.

=== P1 ===
Strict session_id/conversation_id only; reject generation/thread; alias disagreement = conflict.

=== P1 ===
allowLegacyPointer:true bridge; unresolved tombstones prior success; rails/sessionStart agreement fixtures.

=== P1 ===
rails-checker + rails-guard in T64 scope (not frozen) for canonical ticket reader agreement.
User-scoped control state; T64 owns fenced P5 marker helper.

=== P1 ===
Every terminal resolution writes success or tombstone; nested-subagent lineage for P5.


(Renumbered from T62 → T64 so main's T62/T63 fleet/hollow-test contracts stay intact for rails-guard.)

title: Cursor deeper-native: pin hook payloads + ship sessionStart ticket context
